info.title: QuickBooks Online Accounting API: the answers read by wp-woo-idempotent-importer
info.description: Built from Intuit's data model XML Schemas (intuit/QuickBooks-V3-Java-SDK at commit c4d5dfad23ffebf0302356876d0dc389708513a9, ipp-v3-java-data/src/main/xsd): each complex type an object, an element that may repeat an array, simple content `value` beside its attributes; nothing required.
